item.title: 深度学习运行环境搭建
item.description:
1. conda

1.1 常用命令

  • conda env list
  • conda remove -n yourname –all
  • conda install –use-local cudatoolkit-11.1.74-h6bb024c_0.tar.bz2
  • conda create -n qlibven python=3.8
  • conda activate qlibven
  • conda create -n rdagent python=3.10
  • conda activate rdagent

1.2 创建python39ven环境

  • conda create -n python39ven python=3.9
  • conda activate python39ven
  • conda deactivate
  • jupyter notebook

1.3 mxnet 安装方式

  • conda create -n python36mxnet15 python=3.6
  • conda activate python36mxnet15
  • conda deactivate

1.4 tensorflow-gpu 安装方式

  • conda create -n python37tf24ven python=3.7
  • conda activate python37tf24ven
  • conda deactivate
  • jupyter notebook

1.5 ptorch-1.8 安装方式

  • conda create -n python37torch18lts python=3.7
  • conda activate python37torch18lts
  • conda deactivate
  • jupyter notebook

2. Jupyter Notebook

  • pip install jupyterlab
  • pip install notebook
  • pip install voila
  • jupyter notebook

3. git命令

  • git add filename
  • git commit -m “commont”
  • git push -u origin main
  • git remote
  • git status
  • git clone –recursive git@github.com:dmlc/xgboost.git

4. supervisor

  • supervisord -c ./conf/supervisor.new.conf
  • restart mmserver
  • supervisorctl status
  • supervisorctl stop mmserver
  • supervisorctl start mmserver
  • supervisorctl restart mmserver
  • supervisorctl reread
  • supervisorctl update
  • supervisorctl reload

5. 查看进程

  • ps -ef |grep mmserver

6. 上线准备

  • pip install virtualenv
  • virtualenv -p python3.10 .venv
  • virtualenv -p python3.11 .venv
  • virtualenv -p python3.12 .venv
  • virtualenv -p /home/victor/anaconda3/envs/python39ven/bin/python3.9 venv
  • virtualenv -p /home/victor/miniforge3/envs/python38ven/bin/python3.8 venv
  • virtualenv -p /home/victor/miniforge3/envs/python38ven/bin/python3.8 venv
  • virtualenv -p /home/victor/bin/miniforge3/envs/python38ven/bin/python3.8 venv
  • virtualenv -p /Users/victor/bin/anaconda3/envs/python39ven/bin/python3.9 venv
  • virtualenv -p /Users/victor/bin/anaconda3/envs/python312ven/bin/python3.12 venv
  • source venv/bin/activate
  • pip install -r requirements.txt -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
  • CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 python mmserver.py
  • 下载Miniforge（https://conda-forge.org/miniforge/），建议选择Miniforge3。
  • Miniforge3-23.3.1-1-MacOSX-x86_64.sh
  • mamba install -c conda-forge jupyterlab
  • mamba install numpy
  • mamba install seaborn
  • mamba install openpyxl
  • mamba install pandas
  • mamba install scikit-learn

7. docker

  • 本地机器安装docker
  • sudo apt-get update
  • sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit-base
  • sudo systemctl daemon-reload
  • sudo systemctl restart docker
  • 打包服务
  • docker build -f Dockerfile -t tag2text:latest .
  • 运行服务
  • docker run –gpus all -d –name tag2text_mmserver -p 8888:8888 -i tag2text:latest -P tag2text python mmserver.py 8888
  • docker run -t -i tag2text /bin/bash

8. screen

  • screen -S name
  • ctrl a+d
  • screen -ls
  • screen -r id or name

9. tmux

  • conda install tmux
  • tmux ls
  • tmux attach -t 0
  • Ctrl+b d

10. gpustat

  • pip install gpustat -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
  • gpustat -i
